## Episode Thesis

Nasdaq Stockholm CEO Adam Kostiál discusses ahead of the Swedish election the need for a holistic capital-market policy (ISK, pensions, option programs for talent retention, deregulation) to keep equity markets a financing engine for Swedish companies. He is optimistic about the IPO pipeline, expecting Sweden to have Europe's most active listing market through autumn, including small/mid-caps and software companies whose valuations have recovered. No specific listed companies are analysed; only the exchange operator and advertisers are named.
